title: NetworkCall
description: A log entry for a single HTTP, gRPC, or GraphQL network request.

trace_id.description: Unique ID to group original requests and their retries.

request_headers.description: Key-value pairs of request headers (serialized as JSON in SQLite).

request_body.description: The raw body or a reference to the OPFS file path.

request_type.description: Determines how the request_body should be parsed.

status_code.description: HTTP response code. Null if timeout or network error occurs.

response_body.description: The raw response or a reference to the OPFS file path.

response_type.description: The MIME type or category (e.g., application/json, image/png).

ip_address.description: The resolved IP of the server.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the request was initiated.
